name: Code Passenteide
original_name: コード・パッセンテーデ
source:
Code Passenteide is a Ninja of the Magic Kingdom of Zeth who appears exclusively in Kichikuou Rance.

Prior to the events of Kichikuou Rance, Code served as a captain within the Bear Group of the Zethan branch of the Angel Army, a terrorist group created for the sake of improving the rights of Gal Monsters everywhere. Following the defeat of [url=/c97947]Archibald[/url], the organization's leader, all branches of the Angel Army were disbanded. Sometime following this, Code enlisted in the Zeth Army, where he became a member of its Ninja Corps, a division specializing in infiltration and assassination. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Code_Passenteide]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
